title: Operational Dashboards, Release Health, SLOs, and Alerting Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies operational dashboards, release health, slos, and alerting?
options: Build version-aware decision views with population, tail or user-impact signals, data quality, thresholds, owners, and rehearsed actions.
questions.answer: Build version-aware decision views with population, tail or user-impact signals, data quality, thresholds, owners, and rehearsed actions.
questions.explanation: This answer keeps the ownership boundaries distinct and requires version-matched evidence, failure testing, compatibility, and operational follow-through.

questions.prompt: If the global crash-free rate meets its target, no per-device release gate is necessary.
questions.explanation: A green global average can hide a catastrophic regression isolated to one common device model or OS version.

questions.prompt: What makes a release-health alert actionable?
questions.answer: It names user impact, affected cohort, trustworthy evidence, owner, urgency, and an immediate safe response.
questions.explanation: The answer identifies the mechanism and owner that make the explanation causal rather than a memorised sequence.
